title: Hierarchical Bayesian optimization of an aircraft-based multi-agent system-of-systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.22130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developing innovative system architectures increasingly relies on advanced modeling and optimization techniques to frame the architecting process and define the corresponding computational problems. For complex System-of-Systems (SoS), high-fidelity multiphysics and multidisciplinary simulations are essential for capturing detailed behaviors. However, their computational expense and the risk of evaluation failures make direct optimization challenging. To overcome these limitations, surrogate-based approaches, like Bayesian optimization, have emerged as effective tools for managing expensive, black-box simulation tasks. This work introduces a hierarchical Bayesian optimization framework that leverages Gaussian process meta-modeling to handle discrete architectural choices, conditional dependencies, and heterogeneous design variables inherent to SoS problems. translated_title: 基于飞机的多智能体系统之系统的分层贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 开发创新的系统架构越来越依赖于先进的建模与优化技术来构建架构设计过程并定义相应的计算问题。对于复杂的系统之系统而言，高保真的多物理场与多学科仿真对于捕捉其详细行为至关重要。然而，其高昂的计算成本以及评估失败的风险使得直接优化充满挑战。为了克服这些限制，基于代理模型的方法（如贝叶斯优化）已成为管理昂贵黑箱仿真任务的有效工具。本工作提出了一种分层贝叶斯优化框架，利用高斯过程元模型来处理系统之系统问题中固有的离散架构选择、条件依赖关系以及异构设计变量。结果表明，这种分层表述方式提高了搜索效率和鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高斯过程元模型的分层贝叶斯优化框架，能够高效处理基于飞机的多智能体系统之系统架构优化中的离散架构选择、条件依赖和异构设计变量问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a hierarchical Bayesian optimization framework leveraging Gaussian process meta-modeling to efficiently handle discrete architectural choices, conditional dependencies, and heterogeneous design variables in aircraft-based multi-agent system-of-systems architecture optimization.
